[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT): Sprinting on the treadmill for 20-30 seconds followed by walking or jogging for 1-2 minutes, repeated for 20-30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Long Slow Distance (LSD) Training: Sustained periods of moderate-intensity exercise for 30-60 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Strength Training: Focus on exercises like squats, lunges, deadlifts, and leg press, aiming for 2-3 sessions per week.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Plyometric Exercises: Jump squats, box jumps, and burpees to improve power and endurance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Hill Sprints: Sprint uphill for 20-30 seconds, then walk or jog back down, repeated for 20-30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Endurance Circuits: Circuit of exercises like squats, lunges, push-ups, and rows for 20-30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Always warm up before starting any workout and cool down afterwards to prevent injury.
